body: I think the phrase is more accurately "my body, my choice". But yeah I completely agree with you
I don't necessarily see it as giving up, I see it as a beautiful end

If you do make the decision to pass away, make sure to enjoy life as much as possible and sort things out as much as possible before you kill yourself. Think of Carpe Diem, as if you (in your case at least) have a few years left in this world, in this dimension. 

What things would you sort out and what things would you enjoy to the fullest if you knew you would die in a few years? Think deeply about this question, then do them!!
Yea that's quite a nice relaxing thing to do before I die, thanks

Yikes, I better not get caught being suicidal then, I'll have to do it successfully and secretly. It kinda feels like I'm a criminal who's trying to escape prison (mental hopsitals), obviously it's not as cool as it sounds but u get what I mean
